globalPromptSuffix: Production-quality isolated game-audio source layer. Dry and clean. No music, melody, beat, speech, voices, animals, or unrelated background ambience unless explicitly requested. No mastering limiter pumping.

layers.instruction: Render only the immediate onset and transient attack. Very short, crisp, no body resonance, debris, reverb, or tail.
Render only the central material body and weight. No sharp attack, loose debris, ambience, or long tail.
Render only the small secondary texture and debris response. No main impact, music, ambience bed, or long reverb.
Render only the natural decay and environmental tail after the event. No new attack, dialogue, melody, or repeated impacts.
Create a seamless loop containing only the low-frequency environmental bed. Stable level, no accents, melody, voices, or audible loop click.
Create a seamless loop containing only the mid-frequency material texture. No low drone, sharp accents, melody, voices, or audible loop click.
Create a seamless loop containing only subtle high-frequency environmental detail. Sparse and natural, no body drone, melody, voices, or loop click.
Create a seamless sparse accent layer with isolated irregular events and silence between them. No constant bed, music, voices, rhythm, or loop click.
